value.rationale: The originating 2023 GeCo2 stability study leaves the nonhyperbolic equality case and the observed postcritical oscillation without quantitative nonlinear proofs. A global sharp inverse-iteration decay at the stability boundary, an attracting cycle for every supercritical step, and its unusual linear onset and stiff saturation give materially useful benchmarks for positivity-preserving stiff reaction integrators; these are not simply a small parameter adjustment.
